definition:
Conditional-edge analysis per wallet segment (read-only). Inputs: bets_compact.pkl, rankings_fresh.json (or ../v4_cache/rankings.json).
Segments analysed: keep/watch (incl. manual) + any segment with >=50 clean settled bets.
Clean bet = pre-game, held to settlement, entry 0.05-0.95, stake>=$10 (same as the ranking).
Buckets: size vs the wallet's own median stake (<0.8x, 0.8-1.2x, 1.2-2x, 2-3x, >3x) and entry-price bands (<40c, 40-60c, 60-85c, >85c).
Per bucket: bets, win rate (push=0.5), avg entry, flat ROI (mean res/entry-1 = copying at their price, no fee), win rate - implied (avg entry),
lcb90 = ROI - 1.645*sqrt(sum((1-p)/p)/n^2), and an empirical-Bayes shrunk ROI (prior fitted across all buckets of that kind).
Flag 'conditional specialist': segment overall flat ROI within +-3% (near flat) while one bucket has n>=40, shrunk ROI>=+3% AND lcb90>0,
and the bucket is positive in BOTH halves of the segment's history (persistence check). -> conditional_edges.json / .md

price_floor_test.note: keep/watch segments pooled; flat ROI copying every clean bet at the trader's own entry, no fee
